offline_maps.delete_message: The maps are removed from this device. You can download them again later.
offline_maps.description: Download your department's maps so they keep working without a connection.
offline_maps.error.cancelled: Download stopped. It resumes where it left off.
offline_maps.error.disabled: Offline maps are not available for your department.
offline_maps.error.download_http_error: The server could not send a map file.
offline_maps.error.download_network_erro: The connection was lost. The download resumes where it stopped.
offline_maps.error.download_url_expired: A download link expired. Check for updates and try again.
offline_maps.error.insufficient_storage: Not enough free space on this device. Free up space and try again.
offline_maps.error.integrity_failed: A map file failed verification and was discarded.
offline_maps.error.manifest_http_error: The server could not provide the offline map list.
offline_maps.error.manifest_invalid: The offline map list from the server could not be read.
offline_maps.error.manifest_network_erro: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.
offline_maps.error.manifest_not_found: No offline maps have been prepared for your department yet.
offline_maps.error.manifest_url_expired: The offline map link has expired. Reopen the app to get a new one.
offline_maps.error.manifest_url_missing: The server did not provide offline maps for your department.
offline_maps.error.manifest_url_untruste: The offline map address is not on your Resgrid server, so it was not used.
offline_maps.error.missing_hash: A map file could not be verified and was skipped.
offline_maps.error.no_session: Sign in to download offline maps.
offline_maps.error.nothing_to_download: There is nothing to download yet.

offline_maps.error.pack_too_large: This map is larger than the allowed size and was not downloaded.
offline_maps.error.response_area_too_lar: The response area is larger than the allowed size. Ask an administrator to reduce it.
offline_maps.error.size_mismatch: A map file did not have the expected size and was discarded.
offline_maps.error.storage_error: A map file could not be saved on this device.
offline_maps.error.unsafe_url: A map file address was not secure and was skipped.
offline_maps.error.unsupported_kind: This map type needs a newer version of the app.
offline_maps.error.unsupported_platform: Offline maps are not available on this device.
offline_maps.error.waiting_for_wifi: Connect to Wi-Fi to continue, or turn off Wi-Fi only.
offline_maps.stale_warning: These maps have not been updated for a while. Connect to the internet to refresh them.
offline_maps.title: Offline maps
offline_maps.unavailable: Offline maps are not available for your department.
offline_maps.unsupported: Offline maps are not available on this device. Maps you viewed recently stay cached.
offline_maps.wifi_only_note: Downloads wait for Wi-Fi so they do not use mobile data.
